exam: 2021年6月 第3套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: Boredom has become trendy.…

sents.cn: 无聊已经变得时髦起来。

sents.en: Studies point to how boredom is good for creativity and innovation, as well as mental health.
sents.cn: 研究指出，无聊有益于创造力和创新，也有益于心理健康。

sents.en: It is found that people are more creative following the completion of a tedious task.
sents.cn: 研究发现，人们在完成一项枯燥任务后更具创造力。

sents.en: When people are bored, they have an increase in "associative thought"·the process of making new connections between ideas, which is linked to innovative thinking.
sents.cn: 当人们无聊时，他们的"联想思维"会增加——即在各种想法之间建立新联系的过程，这与创新性思维相关。

sents.en: These studies are impressive, but in reality, the benefits of boredom may be related to having time to clear your mind, be quiet, or daydream.
sents.cn: 这些研究令人印象深刻，但在现实中，无聊的好处或许与拥有清空头脑、安静独处或做白日梦的时间有关。

sents.en: In our stimulation-rich world, it seems unrealistic that boredom could occur at all.
sents.cn: 在我们这个充满刺激的世界里，无聊似乎根本不可能发生。

sents.en: Yet, there are valid reasons boredom may feel so painful.
sents.cn: 然而，无聊之所以可能如此痛苦，是有充分理由的。

sents.en: As it turns out, boredom might signal the fact that you have a need that isn't being met.
sents.cn: 事实证明，无聊或许是在发出信号：你有一种需求没有得到满足。

sents.en: Our always-on world of social media may result in more connections, but they are superficial and can fail to build a real sense of belonging.
sents.cn: 我们永远在线的社交媒体世界或许带来了更多联系，但这些都是肤浅的，无法建立真正的归属感。

sents.en: Feeling bored may signal the desire for a greater sense of community and the feeling that you fit in with others around you.
sents.cn: 感到无聊，或许是在暗示你对更强的社群意识、以及融入周围人群的渴望。

sents.en: So take the step of joining an organization to build face-to-face relationships.
sents.cn: 所以，迈出新的一步，加入一个组织去建立面对面的关系吧。

sents.en: You'll find depth that you won't get from your screen no matter how many likes you get on your post.
sents.cn: 你会发现一种深度，那是无论你在帖子上获得多少点赞都无法从屏幕中得到的。

sents.en: Similar to the need for belonging, bored people often report that they feel a limited sense of meaning.
sents.cn: 与对归属感的需求类似，感到无聊的人常说自己意义感有限。

sents.en: It's a fundamental human need to have a larger purpose and to feel like we're part of something bigger than ourselves.
sents.cn: 拥有更宏大的目标、并感觉自己是比自身更宏大事物的一部分，是人类的基本需求。

sents.en: When people are bored, they're more likely to feel less meaning in their lives.
sents.cn: 当人们无聊时，他们更可能在生活中感到意义缺失。

sents.en: If you want to reduce boredom and increase your sense of meaning, seek work where you can make a unique contribution, or find a cause you can support with your time and talent.
sents.cn: 如果你想减少无聊、增强意义感，就去寻找能让你做出独特贡献的工作，或找一个你愿意投入时间与才华去支持的事业。

sents.en: If your definition of boredom is being quiet, mindful, and reflective, keep it up.
sents.cn: 如果你对无聊的定义是安静、专注与反思，那就保持下去。

sents.en: But if you're struggling with real boredom and the emptiness it provokes, consider whether you might seek new connections and more significant challenges.
sents.cn: 但如果你正与真正的无聊及其引发的空虚感作斗争，不妨想想自己是否该寻求新的联系和更有意义的挑战。

sents.en: These are the things that will genuinely relieve boredom and make you more effective in the process.
sents.cn: 这些才是真正能缓解无聊、并让你在此过程中更有效率的东西。
